thread:
sara: Quick sync — customers are requesting branching toolflows: a single chat turn can spawn different tool graphs based on intermediate outputs. Need to decide API shape and launch bar.
mae: Can you sketch the user story? is this a single API surface or an orchestration layer feature?
sara: user story: customer sends user message -> model decides between offer paths A/B -> each path calls 2-3 tools in different orders -> we combine results into final structured output. They want predictable latency and a way to set timeouts per branch.
tony: two high-level modes I see: 1) deterministic sequencing: enforce order, aggregate; 2) speculative branching: run branches in parallel and pick best. Both need different guarantees and cost models.
evan: big runtime impacts: parallel branches blow up tokens + GPU work. We need rate-limiting and estimated cost hints. Also need idempotency keys for retries across branches.
mae: For semantics: propose an explicit "branching" field in the chat/completions API where each branch is a small DAG. Default behavior: run branches in parallel but with a per-branch timeout and a merging policy (first-complete | best-score | merge).
sara: Launch criteria idea: support up to 3 branches, each with <=3 tool calls, per-branch timeout, deterministic merge (first-complete or merge) + SDK helpers. Must be backwards compatible (existing chat calls unchanged).
harry: SDK surface: add Builder.branch().tools([...]).mergePolicy('first'|'merge'|'best').timeoutMs(n). Keep top-level API ergonomic for simple cases.
tony: example proto request (sketch):
```json
{
  "model": "rwd-1-large",
  "input": "Plan trip to SF",
  "branches": [
    {"id":"A","flow":["search","summarize"],"timeout_ms":1200},
    {"id":"B","flow":["calendar","recommend"],"timeout_ms":2000}
  ],
  "merge": {"policy":"first-complete","fallback":"A"}
}
```
evan: Retry rules: if a tool fails with transient error, runtime should retry with exponential backoff but preserve branch idempotency. If a branch times out, optionally attempt fallback branch or partial merge. Need clear error codes.
mae: Runtime optimizations: allow branch-level hints for batching (e.g., allowBatching: true/false) and cacheable KV keys so we can reuse prefix computations across branches. Document cost tradeoffs.
sara: Customer-driven asks: one fintech customer needs strict ordering for audit logs (auditable sequence of tool calls). We need an audit flag to record exact call order and outputs.
harry: Rollout plan: feature-flag behind "branching-v1". Beta with 3 customers, metrics: p99 latency delta <= 2x baseline, error rate < 1%, observable cost delta.
ton y: Canary steps: SDK beta, server-side feature-flag, add quota guardrails (max concurrent branches per org), dashboard tile showing branch-level token usage.
sara: UX question: should we expose per-branch model override? e.g., branch A uses cheaper model for web search, branch B uses higher-quality summarizer.
evan: We can allow per-branch model override but need strict per-request billing attribution and routing. Also increases scheduling complexity.
mae: For GC and cleanup: track branch state & KV lifetimes. If branches share KV prefixes we should garbage-collect after merge TTL.
harry: Docs + compatibility: write migration guide: simple chat-> branches with single implicit branch. Provide examples, rollback steps.
sara: Ok next steps: mae + evan prototype runtime semantics doc (brief) by EOD Friday. tony + harry draft SDK ergonomics + example patch. I'll collect launch criteria and a customer beta list.
mae: ack. I'll include cost simulation numbers.
evan: ack. I'll add retry/error-code table.
sara: thanks — flagging for roadmap sync on Wednesday. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: feature-flag "branching-v1" created for orgs: staging, beta-1.
